releaseNotes: Packaged the engine's command-line face. The skill package now carries a bin: `formation` — one installable dispatcher over the session CLIs in the order a business meets them (bootstrap, plan, run, approve, verify, onboard, schedule). Every subcommand execs the exact TypeScript CLI the audit and fixtures already prove, with exit codes passed through untouched: the bin adds an address, never a second implementation. Before this, an external agent had to know the repository's internal tsx paths to invoke anything (the audit's no-installable-CLI finding).

A new cli fixture suite proves the dispatcher itself: --help lists every command and exits 0, an unknown command is refused by name, and a subcommand demonstrably reaches the real underlying CLI in both directions — a bootstrap dry-run against a throwaway copy of the reference business returns the real plan, and run.ts's own missing-argument error passes through as exit 1.
